title: The Renaissance Revival
theme: The Disney Renaissance, from The Little Mermaid in 1989 to Tarzan in 1999
intro: [excited] Rewind the VHS tape and grab your clamshell case! Tonight is THE RENAISSANCE REVIVAL, ten glorious years from 1989 to 1999 when Disney animation came roaring back. [laughs] Mermaids, genies, lions, gargoyles... it was a LOT, and we loved every minute.

art.prompt: Wide 16:9 title card: a grand Renaissance-style art studio bathed in golden afternoon light, an easel with a blank canvas, a glowing golden oil lamp, a red rose under a glass dome, a jade comb and a seashell on a marble table, oil-painting style No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

categories.title: A Whole New Quiz
categories.intro: [excited] Hop on the carpet! Our film category is 1992's Aladdin. [chuckles] A whole new world of trivia awaits.

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a magic carpet with gold tassels floating above a desert city of domes and minarets under a giant moon, a golden oil lamp glowing on a balcony No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.reveal: The correct answer is Abu! [laughs] Touch the treasure, Abu, and the whole cave falls in. Cute AND chaotic.

clues.clue: The Genie grants how many wishes?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is three! [chuckles] And no wishing for more wishes. The Genie has rules.
The correct answer is Iago, voiced by Gilbert Gottfried. [laughs] Squawk! The loudest bird in Agrabah.

clues.clue: This comedian voiced the Genie in the 1992 film.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Robin Williams! He improvised so much that the animators had hours of material to play with. Phenomenal cosmic powers.

clues.clue: This 1994 direct-to-video sequel brought back Aladdin's old enemy as a genie.
choices: Aladdin and the King of Thieves
Aladdin and the Cave of Wonders
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Return of Jafar! [mischievously] It also launched the Aladdin TV series. Jafar just would not stay in the lamp.

categories.title: Rebirth of Cool
categories.intro: [excited] This themed category covers the whole Renaissance. Heroes, dragons, gorillas and gargoyles. Let's go!

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a sunrise breaking over a valley of iconic 1990s-storybook landmarks: a Greek temple on a mountain, a Chinese palace roof, a jungle treehouse and a Gothic cathedral bell tower, warm golden painterly light No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: The winged horse who helps Hercules.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pegasus! [chuckles] Made from clouds by Zeus himself. Best birthday present ever.
The correct answer is Mushu! [laughs] Dishonor on you, dishonor on your cow... unless you got this one right.

clues.clue: This rock star wrote and sang the songs for Tarzan, winning an Oscar for You'll Be in My Heart.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Phil Collins! [excited] He even re-recorded the songs in German, French, Italian and Spanish. Talk about range.

clues.clue: In 1991, Beauty and the Beast became the first animated feature nominated for this Academy Award.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Best Picture! The Best Animated Feature category didn't even exist until 2001. A tale as old as... ten years later.

clues.clue: In The Hunchback of Notre Dame, Quasimodo's gargoyle friends are Victor, Hugo and this one.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Laverne! [laughs] Victor, Hugo... put those together and you get the author of the original novel. Sneaky, Disney.

categories.title: Emoji-naissance
categories.intro: [chuckles] Our gimmick category is emoji! Decode the little pictures to name a Renaissance-era Disney film.

clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Lion King! [excited] It means no worries, for the rest of your days.
The correct answer is Pocahontas! [sighs] Can you paint with all the colors of the wind? I can barely paint a fence.

categories.title: Zoom with a View
categories.intro: [mischievously] We start super close and slowly zoom out. Buzz in the moment you know which Renaissance film this scene comes from. [whispers] The sooner, the braver.

categories.title: Renaissance Rides
categories.intro: [excited] Our parks category is where you can find the Renaissance in the theme parks. Magic carpets, Tiki birds and lions, oh my!

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a theme-park plaza at golden hour with a carpet-shaped spinning ride, a colorful tiki hut surrounded by tropical flowers and a grand open-air theater with banners of savanna sunsets, no signage No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: At Magic Kingdom's Adventureland, you can spin through the air on The Magic Carpets of this hero.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Aladdin! [laughs] Watch out for the spitting camels. They have terrible aim... or great aim.

clues.clue: Festival of the Lion King is a big stage show in this Walt Disney World park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Animal Kingdom! [excited] Acrobats, giant puppets and a whole lot of Circle of Life.

clues.clue: At Magic Kingdom, you can dine inside the Beast's castle at this restaurant named after a famous song.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Be Our Guest Restaurant! [whispers] Ask nicely and you might peek into the West Wing. Do NOT touch the rose.

clues.clue: Beauty and the Beast Live on Stage plays at this outdoor theater on Sunset Boulevard at Disney's Hollywood Studios.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Theater of the Stars! [sighs] Be our guest, take a seat, and try not to cry at the ballroom dance.

clues.clue: From 1998 to 2011, Magic Kingdom's Enchanted Tiki Room was 'Under New Management,' run by Iago and this hornbill from The Lion King.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Zazu! Iago and Zazu bossing around the Tiki birds. The original birds took the place back, and frankly, good for them.
